patches.description: Collapse MOND redundancy in SEC-1.5 kernel-of-truth paragraph. Curmudgeon c2 H2 flagged two adjacent clauses making the same galactic-dynamics scope point.
patches.find_pattern: MOND treats g† as a transition scale for galactic dynamics; there is no MOND-theoretical — or any-theoretical — justification for interpreting it as a medium density. The McGaugh relation describes gravitational accelerations in low-acceleration regimes of galactic dynamics — it is not a constraint on a medium that human beings walk through. Importing the value without auditing what it means for ordinary motion is the error.
patches.replace_pattern: MOND treats g† as a transition scale for galactic dynamics — it constrains low-acceleration galactic motion, not a medium that human beings walk through. Importing the value without auditing what it means for ordinary motion is the error.

Implementing c12 geometric upper bound instead, achieving the intent without an erroneous value.
